name: Mayu ~Yuki no Knife~
source:
A letter arrived to main character from a childhood friend asking to return to his hometown. At the station he is met my a maid and guided to the mansion.
At night one of the guests of the mansion is found dead. Then another one. What's the motive of the criminal? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公收到青梅竹马寄来的信，请他回到故乡。抵达车站后，一名女仆前来迎接，把他带往宅邸。
当天夜里，宅邸的一名客人被发现死亡，随后又有一人遇害。凶手的动机究竟是什么？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vndb-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
